tasks.label: Render PCB 3D Views (Headless KiCad)
tasks.command: & 'C:\Program Files\KiCad\10.0\bin\kicad-cli.exe' pcb render --output '${workspaceFolder}/dashboard/renders/isometric.png' --rotate '-45,0,30' --perspective --floor --quality high --width 1600 --height 1000 '${workspaceFolder}/sf hall ai pcb/sf hall ai pcb.kicad_pcb'
